%S Axxxxx-d2diag 0,1,1,1,1,5,5,10,9,32,28,76,61,211,166,530,388,1415,1015
%N Axxxxx-d2diag Number of free polyplets (A030222) with n cells whose symmetry group is the order-4 group generated by reflections in the two diagonal axes.
%C Axxxxx-d2diag A polyplet (polyking) is a set of unit cells joined through shared edges or corners. The square symmetry group D4 partitions the free polyplets A030222 into 8 classes by exact symmetry group; this is one of them. The five reflection-containing classes (axial, diagonal, two-axis, two-diagonal, full) sum to A030234 (bilaterally symmetric); the other three (asymmetric, 180-degree, 90-degree) sum to A030235. Polyplet analogue of A056878 (polyominoes). - _[submitter]_, 2026
%F Axxxxx-d2diag Obtained via the table of marks of the square symmetry group D4 from the counts of fixed polyplets (A006770) invariant under each subgroup. The 8 symmetry classes partition A030222(n), and the five reflection classes sum to A030234(n); both checked for all n <= 19.
%Y Axxxxx-d2diag Cf. A030222 (free polyplets), A030234, A030235, A006770 (fixed polyplets), A056878 (polyomino analogue).
%K Axxxxx-d2diag nonn,more
%O Axxxxx-d2diag 1,6
